pass_a_gloss: In many letters, the stranger places a word of the coming to be constructed, and now since it was about to deserve on behalf of Onesimus according to his own worth—and his worth is to be bound—he shows the trustworthyness of the appeal.
pass_b_english: In many letters, he sets down a word as a stranger, one intended to be constructive; and now, since it was about to claim something on behalf of Onesimus according to his own worth—and his worth is to be in bondage—he demonstrates the trustworthiness of the appeal.
source_text:
Fragmentum in epistulam ad Philemonem (in catenis)
Phm
1,1 Ἐν πολλαῖς ἐπιστολαῖς ξένον τίθησι ῥῆμα τοῦ μέλλοντος εἰσάγεσθαι λόγου
κατασκευαστικόν, καὶ νῦν ἐπειδὴ ἔμελλεν ἀξιοῦν ὑπὲρ Ὀνησίμου τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ἀξίᾳ–
ἀξία δὲ αὐτοῦ τὸ δεδέσθαι–, τὸ ἀξιόπιστον τῆς παρακλήσεως δείκνυσιν.
